# ============================================
# Mobile API URL Configuration
# ============================================
# This file contains the active ngrok URL for the mobile app
# Update this file whenever ngrok URL changes
# Both backend and mobile build process reference this file
# ============================================

# Active Ngrok URL (HTTPS only - required for Android)
# Format: https://your-ngrok-url.ngrok-free.dev
# Example: https://abc123.ngrok-free.dev

NGROK_URL=https://unmutated-nondeprecatively-bonnie.ngrok-free.devcd

# Backend API Base URL (auto-generated from NGROK_URL above)
# This is what the mobile app will use
API_BASE_URL=https://unmutated-nondeprecatively-bonnie.ngrok-free.devcd/api

# Instructions:
# 1. Start ngrok: ngrok http 8000
# 2. Copy the HTTPS URL (not HTTP) from ngrok dashboard
# 3. Update NGROK_URL above
# 4. API_BASE_URL will be automatically set to: ${NGROK_URL}/api
# 5. Rebuild APK: npm run build:apk
